sites.name: Kitchen Butterfly
sites.note: Long-running blog by Nigerian food writer and historian Ozoz Sokoh, with Nigerian and New Nigerian recipes.

sites.name: Sisi Yemmie
sites.note: Nigerian home cooking recipes and meal plans, paired with the SisiYemmieTV YouTube channel.

cookbooks.title: My Everyday Lagos: Nigerian Cooking at Home and in the Diaspora
cookbooks.author: Yewande Komolafe
cookbooks.note: Nigerian home cooking adapted for kitchens abroad by a New York Times Cooking contributor.

cookbooks.title: Chop Chop: Cooking the Food of Nigeria
cookbooks.author: Ozoz Sokoh
cookbooks.note: Survey of Nigerian dishes and ingredients from the writer behind Kitchen Butterfly.

sites.name: Eleni's Kitchen Blog
sites.note: Recipes from Ethiopian-born caterer and cooking instructor Eleni Woldeyes near Portland; also promotes her spice and sauce shop.

cookbooks.title: Ethiopia: Recipes and Traditions from the Horn of Africa
cookbooks.author: Yohanis Gebreyesus with Jeff Koehler
cookbooks.note: Broad treatment of Ethiopian cooking by an Addis Ababa chef and TV host.

cookbooks.title: Enebla: Recipes from an Ethiopian Kitchen
cookbooks.author: Luladey Moges

cookbooks.title: Couscous and Other Good Food from Morocco

cookbooks.title: Mourad: New Moroccan

cookbooks.title: Casablanca: My Moroccan Food
cookbooks.author: Nargisse Benkabbou

sites.name: Drizzle and Dip
sites.note: South African recipes section of Cape Town food writer Sam Linsell's blog.

sites.name: TASTE
sites.note: South African recipe collection from the Woolworths food magazine.

sites.name: The Cinnamon Jar
sites.note: South African favourites like bobotie and milk tart from Maretha, a South African home cook in the UK.

cookbooks.title: The South African Cookbook
cookbooks.author: Nokx Majozi
cookbooks.note: Recipes from Cape Town to Durban by a Durban raised chef formerly at Rosewood London.

sites.name: Eat with Afia

sites.name: Fafa Gilbert (Ndudu by Fafa)

cookbooks.title: Eat with Afia: A Celebration of Plant-Based Ghanaian Cooking
cookbooks.author: Afia Amoako
cookbooks.note: Plant based Ghanaian recipes and family food traditions.

cookbooks.title: Ghana to the World: Recipes and Stories That Look Forward While Honoring the Past
cookbooks.author: Eric Adjepong

sites.name: Chez Nermine
sites.note: Egyptian recipes and the stories behind them from Egyptian American cook Nermine.

sites.name: Amira's Pantry

cookbooks.title: Eat, Habibi, Eat!: Fresh Recipes for Modern Egyptian Cooking
cookbooks.author: Shahir Massoud

cookbooks.title: The Taste of Egypt: Home Cooking from the Middle East
cookbooks.author: Dyna Eldaief

sites.name: Nairobi Kitchen

sites.name: Pika Chakula
sites.note: Kenyan and East African recipes such as kuku paka and mandazi.

cookbooks.title: Senegal: Modern Senegalese Recipes from the Source to the Bowl
cookbooks.author: Pierre Thiam with Jennifer Sit

cookbooks.title: The Tunisia Cookbook: Healthy Red Cuisine from Carthage to Kairouan

sites.name: Amour de Cuisine

sites.name: Immaculate Bites

sites.name: A Kitchen in Uganda

sites.name: Princess Tafadzwa
sites.note: Zimbabwean recipes using Shona ingredients and dish names, alongside craft posts.
